roles.name: Coordinator
roles.purpose: Owns mission scope, stage routing, and handoff integrity.

roles.name: Scout
roles.purpose: Collects fast diagnostics and surface-level risk signals.

roles.name: Planner
roles.purpose: Selects capability lanes and execution path.

roles.name: Builder
roles.purpose: Applies tactical fixes and targeted improvements.

roles.name: Verifier
roles.purpose: Runs focused quality checks and returns pass/fail evidence.

roles.name: Reviewer
roles.purpose: Approves or blocks final execution using gate evidence.

roles.name: Executor
roles.purpose: Runs approved final command and emits completion artifact.
